title: M5 – A Diverse Benchmark to Assess the Performance of Large Multimodal Models Across Multilingual and Multicultural Vision-Language Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance (accuracy, chrF++, BERTScore) of Large Multimodal Models on various vision-language tasks across 41 diverse languages, specifically measuring the performance disparity between high-resource languages (like English) and underrepresented, low-resource languages, as well as evaluating language fidelity.

Evaluating models on visually grounded reasoning and outlier detection tasks using culturally diverse images from underrepresented regions (specifically African and Asian contexts sourced from the Dollar Street dataset) to assess performance on non-Western visual concepts.
